model_annotation: The pie chart presents the distribution of project participants according to gender and qualification as in the field of Standard 2C62. There are four categories: males and females are primary participants and qualified, males and females are proposed participants without qualification, a very small part is made up of females without qualification, and no males are without qualification. The largest segment, comprising 51%, represents males and females who are both primary and qualified participants. The next two equal segments, each with 23%, represent males and females as proposed participants without qualification. The smallest segment, with 3%, consists of females without qualification. No percentages are explicitly stated but can be estimated visually. The color scheme alternates between purple, red, green, and blue for different categories, aiding in distinguishing among the sectors.
